title: Descent of signed symmetry naturality from K-flat representatives
statement: For a normalized rational Verdier datum, if its signed symmetry is natural on K-flat chain representatives, then it is natural in both variables for arbitrary derived maps in the ordinary tensor presentation.

proof.text: Replace each derived object by a K-flat representative and lift each derived map to a roof. Transport the chain-level commutative square along representative isomorphisms; roof independence follows from functoriality of the derived localization.

lean.statement:
theorem datum_naturality_of_kflat
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE)
    (hflat : ∀ (P P' Q Q' : CochainComplex (IntegralHom.Modules.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)) ℤ)
        (hP : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P)
        (hP' : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P')
        (hQ : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q)
        (hQ' : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q')
        (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'),
        A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map g)) ≫
            (A.symmetry.swap (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P') (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q')).hom =
          (A.symmetry.swap (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
            A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map g)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) :
    ∀ (K L K' L' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
      A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (A.symmetry.swap K' L').hom =
        (A.symmetry.swap K L).hom ≫ A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f)
